prompt:
Create a high-fidelity 9:16 portrait composition mockup for an editable 40-second League of Legends post-match film, not a web page or photographed poster. Preserve reference 1's selected Rift Atlas visual world: flat illustrated Summoner's Rift geography, precise condensed score typography, clear Traditional Chinese text, disciplined editorial rules and generous quiet reading areas. This is a composition variation, not a new identity. User approved replacing fixed jade with match-specific crest-derived accents: BNK FEARX yellow/black and Nongshim RedForce red/black, with chalk-white and near-black neutral reading surfaces. Keep illustrated terrain recognizably forest jade but quieter; never repaint the entire forest yellow/red. Team accents follow teams consistently, not winner or blue/red game side. Original crests references 3 and 4 must be faithfully placed without redesign; any text remains a mockup, final production uses original assets and editable text. Reference 2 is map topology only, diagonally opposed bases and river; no invented tactical arrows, combat positions, timelines, or event markers. Real content ONLY: 賽後判讀; LCK / 2026.08.27; BNK FEARX; NONGSHIM REDFORCE; series score 3–1. Evidence: 輔助 KDA · 系列均值 9 / 2.26; 終局塔數 · 單局 8–1; 每分鐘補刀 · Taeyoon 10.02; source Leaguepedia · 賽後數據. No fabricated claims or additional stats. Clean vector-like illustrated ink quality, no gritty grain, photoreal terrain, cyber HUD, metallic bevel, stock metric cards, fake awards or decorative UI. These metrics are clearly distinguished as series average, single-game final, and player metric, never causal claims.
COMPOSITION B — MAP SPINE: top 10% compact program title/date; next 22% team matchup and large 3–1 horizontal score with clearly labeled crest-backed team accents. Middle 43% central vertical atlas map dominates, along the map's left and right outside edges align the two team identities without placing fake events inside the map. Bottom 25% one clean chalk reading band, three evidence columns with large numerals and readable labels; map and score are two different scales, score primary. Yellow is the FEARX accent, red the NS accent; neutral rules bind the evidence. Do not reproduce the reference's diagonal split; change topology to a central map spine with left/right team territories and grounded reading band. No text over busy illustrated terrain.
